During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] '''group''' operated throughout the [[Sayblohn system/Legends|Sayblohn system]]. Their [[Sayblohn pirate base|base]] was located in the Badlands of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sayblohn]]. The group's [[Unidentified pirate leader (Sayblohn)|leader]] obtained a religious artifact important to the [[Okfili]], which was also being sought by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="RPG" />
